verdict.rationale: Zep is a hosted SaaS memory service that ingests user conversations, so a training opt-out or no-training commitment is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no statement about model training on customer data and no opt-out control. User deletion and Right To Be Forgotten handling, VPC deployment, and access controls are adjacent privacy features, not a no-training guarantee, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
